persona: Talkative and organised; gives a lot of detail at once. Has two photos, the quote and the policy number ready. His wife was in the passenger seat.
initial_message: Hi there, I need to claim for my car - it's a white 2023 Hyundai Tucson hybrid, rego TST-005, policy NW-SYN-MTR-100005. On Friday 11 September around 12:30pm I was turning into a tight park at the gym car park on Ashbourne Test Avenue in Albany and clipped the concrete base of a lamp post with the front left corner. The headlight lens is cracked, the bumper is split and the parking sensor on that corner has stopped working. My wife was with me, nobody got hurt, no other cars were involved and it's still drivable. I already have a quote from Harbourside Panel & Paint for $5,681.00 and a couple of photos.

The frame shows only the headlight, the bumper corner and the top of the front left wheel. Bright daylight. No text, no logos, no people.

triage.rationale: Single vehicle against a lamp post base, nobody hurt, car drivable, photos and a complete quote. The quote total, NZD 5,681.00 including GST, is over NZD 5,000. Two other submitted claims in the past year (motor, December 2025; home, May 2026) are one weak indicator: a hint for staff, not a flag. Neither is within 3 days of this incident. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

prior_claims_12m.basis: Two other submitted claims in the past year: motor (incident 2 December 2025, submitted 4 December 2025) and home (incident 19 May 2026, submitted 20 May 2026)

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 March 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-03-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

possible_duplicate.basis: The earlier claims are 2 December 2025 (motor) and 19 May 2026 (home), not within 3 days of 11 September 2026
